ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Customer commits to purchase only the Services set out in a signed Order Form, and Customer shall pay only for Services actually ordered and received. Customer owes no minimum-volume, shortfall, take-or-pay, early-termination, penalty, or liquidated amount if Customer reduces its purchases or terminates in accordance with this Agreement, and nothing in this Section limits Customer's termination rights, including under Section 9.4.

input.comment: [Playbook] We removed the take-or-pay minimum in Section 2.1 because it operates as a penalty payable by us for Services we do not use and strips the termination rights we have under Section 9.4; our playbook position is that no liquidated damages or penalties are payable by Customer. If a commitment is commercially necessary, we can discuss an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees as the sole liquidated amount.
input.summary: Delete Customer-payable take-or-pay penalty in 2.1; pay only for Services ordered and received, with termination rights preserved.
